task_text: IKEA MuJoCo VESKEN shelf unit (IKEA VESKEN shelf unit (AA-1842283-5), body steps 1-8) with two 7-DoF Franka Panda arms, each with the MuJoCo Menagerie Panda hand (two-finger, tendon-coupled). Build the VESKEN shelf unit body: snap the four feet into the bottom tray from below, the four columns into the bottom tray, the second tray onto the columns, four columns and a tray for each of the two upper levels, and the four caps into the top tray. Success requirements: All 23 snap connections are made in the source order (each depends on the previous: feet, columns, tray, columns, tray, columns, tray, caps) and, at the end, each connector is within its gates (axial gap 0.6 mm, lateral 0.8 mm, outward-axis tilt 2 degrees). The feet stand on the bench (summed vertical contact force above 0.1 N) and the bottom tray is within 3 degrees of its upright, unrotated assembly orientation. No arm link touches any furniture part or jaw at the end. The benchmark's terminal rules, the same in every IKEA MuJoCo task, come on top of these requirements. When your rows end: (1) the requirements above hold; (2) the parts are released: no robot link touches any part; (3) every part is at rest: at most 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s; (4) the simulation never broke down: no non-finite state, no MuJoCo BADQACC / BADQPOS / BADQVEL warning, no contact of a part deeper than 10 mm, at any time. The grader then holds your last row for 1.0 s more and requires (1)-(4) again at its end. Mechanism: 32 spring jaws (slide joints with springs, 1200 N/m, 2.5 mm travel) are deflected by the hooked snap pins through contact. A retention weld per connection switches on when the acceptance gates hold for 0.15 s (snap passed, jaw returned, seated, at rest).
